claim: The unrestricted shared-interaction decision problem over the exact APMA width<=3 typed mosaic is 3SAT-complete under the identity clause partition; therefore a universal polynomial closure of all remaining cycle, hyperedge and high-width interactions is equivalent to SAT in P.
proof_plan: classify every width<=2 clause into 2CNF and every width=3 clause into Horn or dual-Horn by literal polarity count
preserve every source clause exactly in one carrier and prove exact recomposition
show source assignment satisfies the 3CNF iff it satisfies the conjunction of all typed carriers
use standard 3SAT NP-completeness for hardness and direct assignment verification for NP membership
